title: XiangShan XS-Verilog-Library
_note: XiangShan (香山) is the high-performance open-source RISC-V processor from
the Chinese Academy of Sciences (ICT) and the Beijing Institute of Open
Source Chip.  The CORE itself is written in Chisel/Scala, so there is no
Verilog to read without running the Chisel generator; what is swept here is
XS-Verilog-Library, the project's HAND-WRITTEN SystemVerilog arithmetic
units (SRT integer dividers, radix-2/4/16 FP divide-sqrt, LZC, CSA, QDS).
Arithmetic-heavy and self-contained, which makes it good miter material --
but it is a component library, NOT the XiangShan core.
